title: Human heart beating at 61 bpm (Cc-by-3.0)
author: "Benboncan" at Freesound.org http://www.freesound.org/people/Benboncan/
changes: Trimmed to 1.95–4.62 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 25 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Three lub-dub heartbeats. The high-pass is lowered to 25 Hz so the low heart thumps are kept.
